title: Sample law of a uniform randomized assignment
statement: Let $V$ and $D$ be finite sets, with $D$ nonempty. If each variable in $V$ is independently assigned a uniform value from $D$, then the resulting probability law on assignments $V\to D$ is the uniform distribution on the set of all such assignments.
